transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I suppose... well, my family thought I should come. I just... I keep thinking my wife and the kids would be better off if I didn’t wake up. Lately, I've been saying I don't need to see another winter. That's all.
Have you ever felt this way before, where you’ve had thoughts about not wanting to live anymore?
No. I don't... I don't think so. Never really been one to dwell on things like that before. It's just... lately.
How long have you been feeling this way, with thoughts about not wanting to live anymore?
A while, I suppose. I guess it really started... well, after my bowling partner passed away. That was about a year and a month ago. Just... been since then.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you used to like?

I suppose. I just... sit in my chair mostly. Don't really care to do much else. I used to play bridge... tend the garden. Helped with the cooking at church... watched the Cubs. I just... can't make myself care about any of it anymore.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or thinking that you're a burden to others?
I suppose. I just... my mind keeps going over every little thing I did wrong. With him... and with my family. I'm just no good to anybody now. I know I deserve... whatever punishment is coming to me.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy most days?
I don't really know. I haven't noticed. I'm not doing much of anything to... to get tired in the first place. Just sitting there.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or have you felt restless and unable to sit still?
My wife says... I move like I'm walking through deep snow. I don't know. Just getting dressed or... crossing the kitchen takes so long now. I usually just give up before I get much of anything done.
Before this most recent period of feeling down, have you ever had a time when you felt persistently low for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
No... I don't think so. Not like this.
